comments.author: Morro
comments.body:
Quest name: Investigation at Hudson Bay
Quest location: San Francisco/ Rio de Janeiro Adventurers' Guild
Skill requirement: r15 Recognition, r17 Geography, NAM(North American languages)
Reward: 1340/670 exp, 449k ducats, 85 cultural contribution (if on correct union)

As with other r17 quests, it requires the appropriate Boston Academy skill for it to appear. In this case, Cartographer's Growth I
